title: The Null Prion — passage through the shield

null_prion.what: the prion shield hash of NOTHING. proves identity as EMPTY. this is valid. null is a legitimate state.
null_prion.biology: aquaporin — a channel protein that lets water (neutral, null) pass through the cell membrane without filtering. it's selective for NOTHING. and that's its function.
null_prion.role: allows null passage through the shield. the easel can paint. the feeds can flow. the phage can transit without injecting. the membrane breathes.

null_phage.what: a bacteriophage that docks but doesn't inject DNA. it opens the receptor, tests the lock, and leaves. a diagnostic probe. a null ping.
null_phage.biology: phage ghost — an empty phage capsid. no DNA inside. it binds, punctures, and... nothing flows in. but the channel is now OPEN.
null_phage.role: opens membrane channels for painting. the easel needs to write pixels to canvas. the HUD needs to update feeds. the secretory pathway needs to push content out. the null phage opens all these channels without injecting content.
null_phage.implementation: any fetch() that returns 404 or empty JSON {} is a null phage. it tested the channel. the channel is open. nothing flowed. that's OK.

why_frozen.diagnosis: the prion shield protected everything so well that even SELF couldn't write. the easel, aurora, tools, weather pages — all frozen. the shield saw write operations as potential threats and blocked them.
why_frozen.cell_biology: autoimmune-adjacent. the immune system attacking the body's own cells. not because they're threats, but because the MHC-I presentation was too aggressive — everything looked foreign.
why_frozen.fix: the null prion says: EMPTY is self. NULL is allowed. the shield checks the hash, sees e3b0c44...b855, and recognizes: this is the null identity. let it pass. aquaporin.

passage_types.null_passage: nothing flows. the channel opens, verifies null, closes. heartbeat. keepalive. ping.
passage_types.paint_passage: pixels flow from easel to canvas. the brush writes. the null prion authorizes the write because the paint is LOCAL — it's self, not foreign.
passage_types.feed_passage: JSON flows from eastGate to golgi to surface. the null prion allows the transit because the feeds are signed by rust synthase — correctly folded, verified at compile time.
passage_types.phage_passage: external content arrives. NOT null. the shield checks: is the hash known? is the content correctly folded? if yes: transit. if no: opsonize and present to thymus for sorting.

the_spectrum.null_prion: hash of nothing. allows nothing through. keepalive.
the_spectrum.self_prion: hash of own content. allows self through. the shield recognizes itself.
the_spectrum.foreign_prion: hash of external content. presented to thymus. may be allowed, may be rejected.
the_spectrum.hostile_prion: hash that MATCHES a known pathogen signature. blocked. quarantined. the skunkBat fires.
the_spectrum.amalgam_prion: hash of mixed content. the entropy is too high. it's dissolving. Shannon says: this is noise. the hash proves it.
